frequency_question: What proportion of controversial regulatory agency nominations are successfully confirmed by the Senate within a tight legislative window?
membership_rule: Includes Cabinet-level and major sub-Cabinet regulatory agency heads (FDA, EPA, CDC, etc.) facing contentious confirmation hearings since 2000; excludes routine or non-controversial appointments confirmed by unanimous consent.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major health/regulatory cases; highly relevant subset of total historical confirmations.
known_gaps: Excludes nominees who withdrew before floor votes due to insurmountable opposition.
skeleton: Contested health agency nominations over the past four presidential administrations.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 major contested historical nominations evaluated in this specific reference set.
validity_reason: Valid until the end of the current presidential term and Senate composition dynamics.
